claim_summaries: For rational-complex block-diagonal F with block size b=O(log n), the weighted parity coefficient polynomial factors into local phase-aware block polynomials and a charge-transfer tensor of bond dimension at most k+1; exact coefficients and conditional samples are polynomial-time.

For q independent two-site swap blocks, the phase-retaining two-replica orientation tensor has Schmidt rank 4^q across the cut separating paired coordinates, and common-orientation sewing retains exactly 2^-q of squared norm. This is a seam-specific obstruction, not a general impossibility theorem.
limitations: No general determinant-weighted parity sampler, microscopic energy comparison, FPRAS, external validation, or priority certification is claimed.
Exact rank and fixture checks do not establish all tensor-network lower bounds outside the specified cut and block family.
